name: 3D 얼굴 재구성 분석
description: 비디오에서 3D 얼굴 기하학을 재구성하여 딥페이크의 기하학적 불일치를 감지합니다.
useCase: Detecting face 조작 through 3D geometric reconstruction and consistency 분석
mechanism: Fits a 3D Morphable Model (3DMM) to facial regions 에 걸친 video frames and checks geometric consistency. Deepfakes often create faces that do not correspond to a valid 3D structure, producing impossible depth relationships, asymmetric geometry, or inconsistent 3D reconstructions 사이의 frames.
source: Zhu, X. et al. (2016) - Face Alignment Across Large Poses: A 3D Solution, CVPR
algorithm: 3DMM Fitting (BFM/FLAME) + Geometric Consistency + Temporal 3D Trajectory Analysis
parameters: 모델: Basel Face Model, Fitting: iterative optimization, Parameters: 199 shape + 29 expression, Frame window: 30
strengths:
• 3D 기하학적 일관성 검증
• 깊이 불일치 감지
• 2D 조작으로 위조 어려움
• 조명 분석과 보완적
limitations:
• 계산 비용이 높음
• 정확한 3D 복원에 고품질 입력 필요
• 극단적 포즈에서 정확도 저하
• 저해상도 비디오에서 제한적

references.title: Zhu, X. et al. (2016). Face Alignment Across Large Poses: A 3D Solution. CVPR.
Cozzolino, D. et al. (2021). ID-Reveal: Identity-aware DeepFake Video Detection. ICCV.
Deng, Y. et al. (2019). Accurate 3D Face Reconstruction with Weakly-Supervised Learning. CVPR Workshop.
